  • Method Details

    • playerCopiesKeepEyesOnlyWhileAlive

      public static void playerCopiesKeepEyesOnlyWhileAlive(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template, LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic.Copy copy)
      In game: apply a tinted Slimy Eye to yourself, leave the End through its exit portal, and keep the same eyes. Die and respawn: applied eyes are gone. These tests exercise each loader's copy event.

    • useHooksHonorResults

      public static void useHooksHonorResults(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template, LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic.Use use, boolean testRefusal)
      In game: apply and harvest eyes on a cow, boat, armor stand, and head, then self-shear. On Forge repeat inside a claim that refuses the click: state, items, durability, health, and drops stay unchanged. Fabric executes the normal registered callbacks here; repeat its claim-ordering check manually.
